character: Fast, flowing 5.9km circuit that rewards rhythm and momentum. High-speed corners dominate — Maggotts-Becketts is one of the best sequences in racing. Few heavy braking zones means every tenth counts in the fast stuff.
sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/racing/2026/great-britain/circuit official F1 circuit guide; Maggotts-Becketts-Chapel sequence well documented

corners.name: Abbey
corners.technique: Lift or light brake, smooth turn-in, use bump on apex as reference
corners.trap: Using too much exit road compromises Farm entry

corners.name: Farm
corners.technique: Flat or near-flat, smooth inputs, three red kerbs mark apex
corners.trap: Sudden lift-off causes lift-off oversteer at high speed

corners.name: Village
corners.technique: First real braking zone — hard braking, late apex for good exit into The Loop
corners.trap: Early apex leads to running wide and slow Loop entry

corners.name: The Loop
corners.technique: Patient entry, late apex, progressive throttle — exit onto Wellington Straight is critical
corners.trap: Early throttle causes wheelspin; poor exit loses time on the entire straight

corners.name: Aintree
corners.technique: Carry momentum from Loop exit, late apex

corners.name: Brooklands
corners.technique: Hard braking, late apex, clean exit for Luffield
corners.trap: Braking too deep and missing the apex

corners.name: Luffield
corners.technique: Double apex: hit early apex, drift out, tighten for second apex. Exit speed onto Wellington is huge
corners.trap: Single apex line loses exit speed onto the long straight

corners.name: Copse
corners.technique: Requires commitment — flat or tiny lift, smooth steering, trust the grip

corners.name: Maggotts
corners.technique: Quick flick left, clip apex, immediately prepare for right
corners.trap: Over-driving any part of this sequence ruins the whole complex

corners.name: Becketts
corners.technique: Flow through with smooth, quick direction changes — carry as much speed as possible
corners.trap: Fighting the car with big steering corrections; need rhythm and commitment

corners.name: Chapel
corners.technique: Exit speed is everything — feeds the longest straight on the circuit
corners.trap: Getting greedy through Becketts and arriving at Chapel offline

corners.name: Stowe
corners.technique: Brake in a straight line, hit the apex, use exit kerb
corners.trap: Braking too late on the downhill approach

corners.name: Vale
corners.technique: Multiple braking references (gantry, turn-in board, entry kerb). Good exit sets up Club

corners.name: Club
corners.technique: Flat in most cars — exit from Vale is critical, long vision through the corner
corners.trap: Poor Vale exit means slow Club and slow pit straight speed
